prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: VR High School environment concept art. Style: beautiful expressive hand-drawn violet/graphite colored pencil contours, searching construction lines, fine hatching and luminous transparent watercolor washes on warm ivory textured paper; selective detail, visible paper and loose painted edges, sophisticated welcoming fantasy school art. Old Swiss Alpine stone monastery converted into a school: weathered limestone, aged oak, archways, human-scale comfortable furnishings; school rather than haunted dungeon. Environment is the hero, no people or creatures, no UI, no logos, no watermark. Wide landscape image, immersive three-quarter eye-level perspective of one beautiful corner, composition with a strong foreground/middle/background hierarchy, drawing fully composed as a standalone illustration. No collage or panels, no title or text labels. Scene: the male goblin bard's music workshop, a charming semi-basement former monastic rehearsal chamber. Depict a vaulted corner where two stone walls meet; one deep arched window opens above ground on a sunlit Swiss mountain valley. Low ribbed stone vault and exposed oak beams. A warmly worn upright piano tucked into the left alcove, small oak semicircular teaching rug area in the center, one music stand, two mismatched stools; lute, cello and frame drum neatly stored along the right wall, discreet shelves with music books, one terracotta plant. The workshop has personality and musical craftsmanship, uncluttered walking space. Warm honey and muted terracotta washes, sage upholstery, cool lavender stone shadows, powder-blue distant peaks. Honey afternoon window light rakes over wood and instrument edges, a tiny brass wall lamp warms the darker stone. Beautiful believable architectural corner, more developed and richly colored than a pale backdrop, yet unmistakably pencil and wash.

Tall carved oak bookshelves wrap both walls, an upper shelf access ladder, a deeply recessed mullioned Gothic stone window overlooking a Swiss Alpine valley, a curved built-in cushioned window bench, one inviting moss-green reading armchair and a round oak reading table with a small stack of books and a brass reading lamp. A lovely room a teenager would want to spend time in.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished wide landscape environment concept sheet with EXACTLY SIX distinct fully drawn exterior concepts of an OLD MONASTERY CONVERTED INTO A SCHOOL in a Swiss-Alps-like environment. Two rows of three equally sized landscape panels, thin ivory gutters, each view large enough to read architecture and landscape. Style across all six: expressive violet/graphite pencil contours and hatching, loose luminous transparent watercolor wash on warm ivory paper, sophisticated painterly architectural sketchbook, not 3D. Each panel shows the whole distinctive school complex prominently in an inviting three-quarter exterior view, a glimpse of school conversion through classroom windows, books or art at entrances, accessible courtyard paths and schoolyard seating; preserve old monastic cloister/chapel/tower heritage. Vary ARCHITECTURAL MASSING and MOUNTAIN COMPOSITION as strongly as color, six genuinely different design ideas. A small tidy handwritten label below each, only the following exact labels: '01 / Meadow Cloister', '02 / Lakeside Abbey', '03 / High Pass School', '04 / Autumn Courtyard', '05 / Terraced Sanctuary', '06 / Blue Hour Retreat'. 01: low Romanesque limestone quadrangle around a green cloister, single square bell tower, red clay roof, rolling flower meadow with distant jagged snowy peaks; sage/honey/sky blue, fresh morning. 02: taller Gothic grey-stone abbey with slender slate spire and steep roofs beside a turquoise lake, dramatic sheer rock walls behind; jade/slate/pale pink, rose dawn. 03: compact high-altitude hospice monastery, heavy granite walls, sturdy octagonal bell tower, dark timber galleries and snowy roofs, close glacial saddle and layered ridges; icy blue/charcoal/amber windows, clear winter afternoon. 04: broad pale-plaster Baroque monastic school with twin modest onion-capped towers and terracotta roofs, intimate courtyard open to gold larches, distant rounded and sharp Alpine peaks; ochre/rust/dusty lilac, autumn afternoon. 05: stepped medieval monastery built along a sunny mountainside on three stone terraces, asymmetrical square watchtower, timber connectors, a terraced school garden, steep green valley and cascading mountain stream; olive/cream/terracotta, bright late summer. 06: dark-roofed secluded stone-and-timber monastery with a stout square bell tower, pine forest and monumental pyramidal snowy mountain, welcoming warm classroom windows and a small courtyard; cobalt/violet/amber, blue hour. Architecture must feel feasible and old, compact school complexes rather than extravagant fairytale castles. School and mountain silhouettes both clearly readable in every panel. No people as focal subjects, no logos, no watermark. Exactly six scenes on one sheet, landscape format.
